metadata.question: Was the nighttime brightness over northern part of Isabela Island greater than the southern part of Isabela Island at 1:20 am local time on January 7, 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Isabela Island (Galápagos, Ecuador). Need to divide into northern and southern parts. - Date: January 7, 2022 - Data: NOAA VIIRS Nighttime Lights (DNB - Day/Night Band) which captures nighttime brightness - Time: 1:20 am local time (Galápagos is UTC-6, so 1:20 am local = 07:20 UTC) 2. Masking strategy: - VIIRS DNB data is specifically designed for nighttime observations - Need to filter by the specific overpass time or use the closest available image - VIIRS has fixed overpass times (~1:30 am and ~1:30 pm local time) - 1:20 am is very close to the standard nighttime overpass 3. Logic: - Split Isabela Island into northern and southern regions - Calculate mean DNB radiance for each region - Compare the two values - Handle cases: C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (null/invalid results), A (yes, north > south), B (no, south ≥ north) Strategy: - Use NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A1 (Daily DNB Collection) - Filter to January 7, 2022 - Create geometries for northern and southern Isabela - Compare mean DNB brightness ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Define Isabela Island geometries (Galápagos, Ecuador) # Isabela Island approximate coordinates: -0.5 to 0.0 latitude, -91.6 to -90.9 longitude # Split into northern (approx -0.2 to 0.0) and southern (approx -0.5 to -0.2) northern_isabela = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-91.6, -0.2, -90.9, 0.0]) southern_isabela = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-91.6, -0.5, -90.9, -0.2]) # 2. Load VIIRS Nighttime Brightness data (DNB - Day/Night Band) # Collection: NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A1 (Daily 500m resolution) viirs = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A1') # Filter to January 7, 2022 start_date = '2022-01-07' end_date = '2022-01-08' filtered = viirs.filterDate(start_date, end_date) # Check if data exists count_images = filtered.size().getInfo() print(f"VIIRS images found on 2022-01-07: {count_images}") if count_images == 0: print("No VIIRS data for January 7, 2022") print("C1") else: # 3. Get the DNB radiance band (Avg_Rad_DN is the radiance band) # The VIIRS VNP46A1 product has DNB radiance data img = filtered.first() # Select the DNB radiance band dnb = img.select('Avg_Rad_DN') # 4. Calculate mean brightness for northern region north_stats = dnb.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True), geometry=northern_isabela, scale=500, maxPixels=1e8 ).getInfo() north_mean = north_stats.get('Avg_Rad_DN_mean') north_count = north_stats.get('Avg_Rad_DN_count') print(f"Northern Isabela: Mean DNB={north_mean:.3f}, Pixels={north_count}") # 5. import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Define Isabela Island geometries (Galápagos, Ecuador)
# Isabela Island approximate coordinates: -0.5 to 0.0 latitude, -91.6 to -90.9 longitude
# Split into northern (approx -0.2 to 0.0) and southern (approx -0.5 to -0.2)

northern_isabela = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-91.6, -0.2, -90.9, 0.0])
southern_isabela = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-91.6, -0.5, -90.9, -0.2])

# 2. Load VIIRS Nighttime Brightness data (DNB - Day/Night Band)
# Collection: NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A1 (Daily 500m resolution)
viirs = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A1')

# Filter to January 7, 2022
start_date = '2022-01-07'
end_date = '2022-01-08'

filtered = viirs.filterDate(start_date, end_date)

# Check if data exists
count_images = filtered.size().getInfo()
print(f"VIIRS images found on 2022-01-07: {count_images}")

if count_images == 0:
    print("No VIIRS data for January 7, 2022")
    print("C1")
else:
    # 3. Get the DNB radiance band (Avg_Rad_DN is the radiance band)
    # The VIIRS VNP46A1 product has DNB radiance data
    img = filtered.first()
    
    # Select the DNB radiance band
    dnb = img.select('Avg_Rad_DN')
    
    # 4. Calculate mean brightness for northern region
    north_stats = dnb.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
        geometry=northern_isabela,
        scale=500,
        maxPixels=1e8
    ).getInfo()
    
    north_mean = north_stats.get('Avg_Rad_DN_mean')
    north_count = north_stats.get('Avg_Rad_DN_count')
    
    print(f"Northern Isabela: Mean DNB={north_mean:.3f}, Pixels={north_count}")
    
    # 5. Calculate mean brightness for southern region
    south_stats = dnb.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
        geometry=southern_isabela,
        scale=500,
        maxPixels=1e8
    ).getInfo()
    
    south_mean = south_stats.get('Avg_Rad_DN_mean')
    south_count = south_stats.get('Avg_Rad_DN_count')
    
    print(f"Southern Isabela: Mean DNB={south_mean:.3f}, Pixels={south_count}")
    
    # 6. Validation
    if north_count == 0 or south_count == 0:
        print("No valid pixels in one or both regions")
        print("C2")
    elif north_mean is None or south_mean is None:
        print("Calculation resulted in null values")
        print("C3")
    else:
        # 7. Compare
        difference = north_mean - south_mean
        print(f"Difference (North - South): {difference:.3f}")
        
        if north_mean > south_mean:
            print("A")
        else:
            print("B")
